description: Référentiel des arrêts : Accès is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données propose les accès du référentiel des arrêts d'Île-de-France. Cela représente les points de passage obligé par lesquels un voyageur doit passer pour pouvoir accéder aux Arrêts d’une ou plusieurs Zone d’Arrêts (entrée) ou sortir de cette/ces zones (sortie). Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Arrêts. Its keywords are Référentiel, Accès. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
